name: braintrust
description: Explore Braintrust traces, manage prompts and datasets, and run evaluations.

interface.longDescription: Query production traces, investigate failures, manage prompts and datasets, and run evaluations in Braintrust. Sign in with a Braintrust account to access your organization's data. Tools use your account's permissions and can read or modify data. This package connects to Braintrust's US data plane.
defaultPrompt: Summarize recent errors in my Braintrust project.
Compare the results of two experiments in my Braintrust project.
